Delete this file and the ladder says 'She's coming about' instead.

events.body: A ship has come about and is standing toward you, signal flags snapping at her yard. She is asking who you are, and she does not sound inclined to take your word for it.

options.text: Hold the ruse. Answer her signal and keep the gunports shut.
options.outcome: You run up the reply as cool as you like, and wait to see whether she believes it.

options.text: Strike the false colours before she makes us.
options.outcome: Down comes the borrowed flag and up go your own. Her captain makes a note of you. That is all, this time.

options.text: Crowd on sail and run for it.
options.outcome: Every scrap of canvas goes up. Get out of her sight, and the story goes no further.
